text:
sahil: Starting thread: playbook for demote hysteresis + backpressure interaction. seen a few incidents where aggressive demote during spikes caused thrash and p99 blowups. want design + rollout plan.
erin: tl;dr: add hysteresis windows + admission-aware demote thresholds. that should stop flip-flopping for hot prefixes.
sahil: current problem: demote triggers on short-term decline in access rate; immediately evicted prefixes get rehydrated -> expensive reads -> IO/backpressure -> more demotes. feedback loop.
ralph: concrete ask: define demote_score(t) and two thresholds: demote_enter and demote_exit with hysteresis gap. also tie demote_enter to tenant_admission_utilization.
tina: suggested formula: demote_score = w1 * recent_miss_rate + w2 * inverse_access_rate + w3 * kv_write_pressure. sample weights: w1=0.6, w2=0.3, w3=0.1.
corey: pseudocode for gate:
```
if tenant.utilization > 0.8:
  demote_enter = base_enter * 1.5
else:
  demote_enter = base_enter

demote_exit = demote_enter * 0.6
if demote_score >= demote_enter: schedule_demote()
if demote_score < demote_exit: cancel_pending_demote()
```
erin: key: demote_enter scales up under admission load so we avoid creating extra work during throttling. exit threshold lower to be conservative about rehitting demote soon after demote.
sahil: we also need a grace window after demote where we disable demote checks for that prefix (soft quarantine) to avoid immediate re-demote. propose demote_quarantine_ms = 2000ms by default.
ralph: where to keep state? add small state fields in prefix metadata: last_demote_ts, demote_pending, demote_token. costs minimal.
tina: interaction with KV eviction credits: if tenant has spare eviction_credits, we can be aggressive. add quick check: if tenant.eviction_credits > credit_threshold, reduce demote_enter by 20%.
corey: telemetry: emit events: demote_scheduled, demote_cancelled, demote_executed, demote_rehydrate_cost_ms. also counters for hysteresis-triggered cancels. dashboards: demote-flap-rate, demote-induced-rehydration-io.
erin: testing: small sim harness that replays real access traces and artificially toggles tenant admission util. run 10k-prefix sim, measure p95/p99 and total IO ops with/without hysteresis.
sahil: rollout plan: 1) add telemetry + config knobs behind feature flag, 2) enable in staging for internal tenants, 3) enable for 5% of prod tenants with aggressive monitoring, 4) bump to 25/50/100 with rollback guard.
ralph: rollback/guard heuristics: if demote_flap_rate increases > 2x baseline OR p99_read_latency increases > 10% -> rollback. also guard on rehydrate_io_bytes.
tina: corner cases: cold start long-tail where demote_exit never fires because access rate stays very low. ensure we don't block eventual eviction: add absolute max_age_ms after which prefix is demoted unconditionally. default 24h.
corey: implement small adaptive backoff on retries when demote rejects read-paths: if demote_pending and op rejected, schedule exponential retry up to 3 attempts to avoid client thrash.
sahil: ops-level pseudocode for read path:
```
if prefix.demote_pending:
  if prefix.time_since_demote < demote_quarantine_ms: return cached_fallback_or_retry()
  else if demote_score < demote_exit: proceed
  else reject_or_enqueue()
```
erin: please make all knobs tenant-scoped and overridable via admin UI so Customer Success can opt specific tenants in/out.
ralph: perf note: compute demote_score in sliding-window counter aggregator, not per-op. update every 100ms.
tina: I'll add a small chaos test that introduces jitter in admission_utilization to ensure hysteresis reduces oscillation.
corey: I'll own the dashboards and rollback automation. plan to add an alert that annotates spikes with demote events.
pb-bot: CI status: lint ok, unit tests pending.
sahil: thanks. @tina please draft the RFC-followup doc with param tuning recommendations and include the sim results. we'll meet Thurs for sync.
